about: Front ZH0: Simplified Chinese strings that may equal their English source, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-zh.md §5.4): product and organisation names, catalogue acronyms, keys. Words with a Chinese form (OK 确定, Pulsar 脉冲星, Radio 射电) never. Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.original:HH:MM:SS: VIREO's time-format mask, a format code (as ja, ru, fr, hi)
entries.original:YYYY/MM/DD: VIREO's date-format mask, a format code (as ja, hi)
entries.original:V - Mv =: a distance-modulus formula label of symbols (as ja, ru, fr, hi)
entries.original:PDot (S/S):: a pulsar timing parameter symbol and its unit (as ja, hi)
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: a pulsar epoch symbol and its time scale (as ja, ru, hi)
entries.original:(km/sec): a unit (km/s), as VIREO writes it (as ja)
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: a time value and the UT symbol, as Chinese writes it («12:00:00 UT»)
entries.catalog:siteClock.hoursValue: a value and the hour symbol h (hours of right ascension or time), a unit symbol
entries.catalog:runningClock.coordinateValue: coordinate values with the unit symbols h and °, no words
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: a value and the degree sign, no words
entries.catalog:motion.rateOption: a rate value and the multiplication sign (2×), no words
entries.catalog:htl.row: three values joined with · (number, identifier, remarks), no words
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.ir: filter set name (IR), as VIREO's camera writes it
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.catalogEntry: a filter letter and a catalogue band name (NOMAD R), no words
entries.catalog:optionsFile.source.native: VIREO's options file name (VIREO VEO_OPTS.INI), a product and a file name
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty: no reason is shown when the camera is ready
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a source label and a SHA-256 prefix joined with ·, no words
entries.map:camera.rowCounts: three counts joined with /, no words
entries.catalog:hubble.ratioColumn: Front ZH2: a formula and units only (v/D · km/s/Mpc)
entries.catalog:ownResults.sha: Front ZH2: a hash label kept in English (SHA-256) and its value
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.jd: Front ZH2: the Julian date abbreviation kept as JD, as the observatory keeps it (ZH1)
entries.catalog:lss.exposure.elapsed: Front ZH2: a value and the unit symbol ms
entries.catalog:velocity.column: Front ZH2: a format of symbols, units and a number type only (v · km/s · float32)
entries.map:wedge.columns.index: Front ZH2: the number sign as a column header (#)
entries.map:wedge.columns.velocity: Front ZH2: a symbol and its unit, V (km/s)
entries.map:wedge.sha256: Front ZH2: a hash name kept in English (SHA-256)
entries.map:wedge.detail.velocity: Front ZH2: a symbol and a number type (V binary32)
entries.map:wedge.detail.z: Front ZH2: a symbol and a number type (Z binary32)
entries.map:wedge.detail.px: Front ZH2: the pixel unit symbol px
entries.catalog:classLines.option: Front ZH3: a format of a placeholder, the unit symbol Å and a separator
entries.catalog:probe.shaLabel: Front ZH3: a hash label kept in English (SHA-256)
entries.catalog:photo.caption: Front ZH3: placeholders and a separator only
entries.catalog:viewport.range: Front ZH3: placeholders, the unit symbol Å, an en dash and the zoom sign ×
entries.catalog:nativeResults.typeValue: Front ZH3: placeholders and a separator only
entries.catalog:nativeResults.kindValue: Front ZH3: placeholders and a separator only
entries.catalog:program.row: Front ZH3: placeholders and a separator only
entries.catalog:nativeText.choice: Front ZH3: placeholders and a separator only
